raw_text:
{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "cyb3ralbert",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "ACKed after verifying the renewal bound test; previously raised REDOWNLOAD eviction, unbounded renewals, and test coverage concerns (all settled)"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:6161235415",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "A stalled peer that stops responding to getheaders remains connected indefinitely, holding the outbound slot.",
      "quote": "With a single outbound peer, a peer that sends one headers message and then stops responding to `getheaders` remains connected for 24 hours under mocktime, whereas master disconnects it after 24 minut",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author confirmed and pushed bf56f4fb83 renewing the timeout only if presync work increased",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6163775056"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6163775056",
      "status_by_quote": "Pushed bf56f4fb83. The presync work is now recorded when the timeout is set, and when it expires the timeout is only ren"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6161235415",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Whether the Tor/I2P latency scenario is expected to apply when there is only a single outbound peer.",
      "quote": "Is the Tor/I2P latency scenario expected to apply when this is the only outbound peer?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained that logic is independent of peer count",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6163775056"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6163775056",
      "status_by_quote": "Single outbound peer: nothing in the logic depends on how many outbound peers there are, so a slow Tor/I2P link can hit "
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6161235415",
      "part": 3,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "usefulness",
      "text": "Whether the eviction was observed on a real node or inferred from expected round-trip times.",
      "quote": "Was the eviction observed on a real node, or inferred from expected round-trip times?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author confirmed it was inferred from mainnet round trips and reproduced in mocktime tests",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6163775056"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6163775056",
      "status_by_quote": "Real node: no, the eviction was not observed on a real node. It is inferred from the ~480 presync round trips on mainnet"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6185199965",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "During the REDOWNLOAD phase, presync work stops growing and timeout renewals cease, risking eviction of slow peers before the redownload buffer releases headers.",
      "quote": "A peer that needs timeout renewals during presync therefore has only 22–42 minutes after the transition to deliver those headers before being disconnected.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author implemented GetSyncProgress() to cover both presync and redownload in 69e0e7188",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6187005712"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6187005712",
      "status_by_quote": "The renewal now uses a progress counter that covers both phases (`HeadersSyncState::GetSyncProgress()`, presync height +"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6185199965",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Timeout renewals are unbounded, allowing a peer with slow but regular progress to hold an outbound slot indefinitely.",
      "quote": "There does not appear to be a bound on the number of renewals, so a peer making very slow but regular progress can hold the outbound slot for an extended period.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author bounded renewals to MAX_HEADERS_SYNC_TIMEOUT_RENEWALS = 6 in 69e0e7188",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6187005712"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6187005712",
      "status_by_quote": "Renewals: now bounded by `MAX_HEADERS_SYNC_TIMEOUT_RENEWALS = 6`, so a peer can hold the slot for at most ~2h22m through"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6185199965",
      "part": 3,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Call sync_with_ping() on each step or allow extra minutes to make test_presync_peer_stalled_is_evicted less timing-sensitive.",
      "quote": "Calling `sync_with_ping()` on each step, or allowing a few extra minutes, would make the test less timing-sensitive.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated advance_minutes to sync with ping after each mocktime step and increased loop to 50 minutes",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6187005712"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6187005712",
      "status_by_quote": "`advance_minutes` now calls `sync_with_ping()` after every mocktime step and the loop runs to 50 minutes."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6310806124",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Pin the number of renewals in test_headers_sync_renewals_bounded so that the test fails if MAX_HEADERS_SYNC_TIMEOUT_RENEWALS is changed.",
      "quote": "One gap in the new bound test: `test_headers_sync_renewals_bounded` doesn't pin the number of renewals.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "cyb3ralbert verified that the test fails with bound at 5 or 7 and passes with 6",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6311936322"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6334875534",
      "status_by_quote": "with 6 it passes, so the bound is now pinned from both sides."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:6334875534",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "The new commit only touches the functional test; verified test_headers_sync_renewals_bounded fails if the renewal bound is changed to 5 or 7 and passes with 6, pinning the bound from both sides",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "both",
      "areas": [
        "p2p_headers_sync_with_minchainwork.py"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "notes": "cyb3ralbert ACKed after testing d59713ea51 and confirming that test_headers_sync_renewals_bounded properly pins the bound, accepting the final suggestion.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "nothing",
      "what": "all items settled and PR is ACKed",
      "id": "c:6334875534"
    }
  ]
}
